def: 在海量文本上训练、参数量达数十亿以上的神经网络，核心能力是预测下一个词。
defEn: A neural network trained on vast amounts of text with billions or more parameters. Its core capability is predicting the next word.

def: 模型处理文本的最小单位。中文里一个汉字通常约 1-2 个 Token，英文单词约 1-1.5 个。计费与上下文长度都按 Token 算。
defEn: The smallest unit of text the model processes. In English, roughly one token per short word or sub-word. Both billing and context length are counted in tokens.

def: 模型内部可训练的数字权重。常被误认为「知识条目」，实际存储的是语言统计规律。
defEn: The trainable numeric weights inside a model. Often mistaken for 'stored knowledge' — what they actually encode is statistical patterns of language.

def: 模型一次能读取的最大 Token 数，包含输入和输出。窗口大小不等于有效记忆范围。
defEn: The maximum number of tokens a model can read at once, including both input and output. A large window is not the same as reliable recall.

def: 2017 年提出的自注意力架构，是当今几乎所有大模型的基础结构。
defEn: The self-attention architecture proposed in 2017. It underlies essentially every large model in use today.

def: 让模型在处理某个词时，动态决定该「关注」上下文中哪些词。Self-Attention 是 Transformer 的核心。
defEn: Lets the model dynamically decide which words in the context to 'pay attention to' when processing a given word. Self-attention is the core of the Transformer.

def: 把模型拆成多个「专家」子网络，每次推理只激活其中一小部分。参数总量大但实际计算量小。
defEn: Splitting a model into many 'expert' subnetworks, activating only a small subset per inference. Large total parameter count with small actual compute.

def: 图像/视频生成的主流方法。先学习给图片加噪声的过程，再学会反向从噪声还原出图像。
defEn: The dominant method for image and video generation. It learns to add noise to an image, then learns to reverse that process and recover the image from noise.

def: 在海量通用语料上做无监督训练，让模型学会语言本身。成本最高、耗时最长的阶段。
defEn: Unsupervised training on a very large general corpus, teaching the model language itself. The most expensive and slowest stage.

def: 在预训练模型基础上，用特定领域数据继续训练，让模型适应具体任务或风格。
defEn: Continuing to train a pre-trained model on domain-specific data, so it adapts to a particular task or style.

def: 用「问题-标准答案」的成对数据训练，让模型学会按人类期望的格式和方式回答。
defEn: Training on paired question-and-ideal-answer data so the model learns to respond in the format and manner humans expect.

def: 基于人类反馈的强化学习。用人类偏好打分训练奖励模型，再据此优化语言模型，让它「更有用、更无害」。
defEn: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Human preference judgements train a reward model, which then optimises the language model to be more helpful and less harmful.

def: 冻结原模型，只训练一小部分低秩矩阵。让微调显存需求大幅下降，是个人玩家的主流方案。
defEn: Low-Rank Adaptation. Freezes the original model and trains only a small set of low-rank matrices, sharply reducing the VRAM needed for fine-tuning. The standard approach for individual practitioners.

def: 用更低精度（如 4bit）表示模型权重，牺牲少量质量换取显存和速度。本地部署的关键技术。
defEn: Representing model weights at lower precision (4-bit, for instance), trading a little quality for memory and speed. The key technique for running models locally.

def: 让小的「学生模型」学习大的「教师模型」的输出分布，从而以小博大。很多号称「小钢炮」的模型都是这么来的。
defEn: Training a small 'student' model to imitate the output distribution of a large 'teacher' model. Most models that punch above their size work this way.

def: 让模型把中间推理步骤写出来再给结论。能显著提升数学、逻辑类任务的准确率。
defEn: Having the model write out its intermediate reasoning before giving a conclusion. Markedly improves accuracy on maths and logic tasks.

def: 回答前先从知识库检索相关资料，再让模型基于资料作答。解决「模型不知道你的私有数据」问题。
defEn: Retrieving relevant material from a knowledge base first, then having the model answer from that material. Solves 'the model doesn't know your private data'.

def: 把文本转成高维向量，语义相近的文本在向量空间中距离更近。搜索、聚类、RAG 的基础。
defEn: Converting text into a high-dimensional vector, such that semantically similar text lands closer together. The basis of search, clustering and RAG.

def: 专门存储和检索向量的数据库，支持按相似度快速查找，是 RAG 系统的标准组件。
defEn: A database built for storing and retrieving vectors by similarity. A standard component of any RAG system.

def: 模型按约定格式输出「我要调用某个工具及其参数」，由外部程序执行后再把结果喂回模型。Agent 的基础能力。
defEn: The model outputs, in an agreed format, 'I want to call this tool with these arguments'. An external program runs it and feeds the result back. The foundation of agents.

def: 能自主规划多步任务、调用工具、根据反馈迭代的 AI 系统，区别于只回答一次的对话模型。
defEn: An AI system that plans multi-step tasks, calls tools and iterates on feedback — as opposed to a chat model that answers once.

def: 统一 AI 与外部工具/数据源对接方式的开放协议，把 N×M 的适配工作降为 N+M。
defEn: An open protocol standardising how AI connects to external tools and data sources, reducing N×M integrations to N+M.

def: 通过设计输入的结构、角色、约束和示例，稳定地获得高质量输出的方法。
defEn: Designing the structure, role, constraints and examples of an input in order to get consistently high-quality output.

def: 在提示词里给几个示例，让模型照着做。通常比纯描述期望更有效。
defEn: Putting a few examples in the prompt and letting the model follow the pattern. Usually more effective than describing what you want in prose.

def: 在回答前先进行较长内部思考的模型，用更多推理时计算换取更高准确率，适合数学、代码、复杂规划。
defEn: A model that thinks at length internally before answering, trading more inference compute for higher accuracy. Suited to maths, code and complex planning.

def: 在推理阶段投入更多算力（延长思考、多路径采样再选优）来提升答案质量，而非只靠增大模型。
defEn: Spending more compute at inference time — longer thinking, sampling multiple paths and choosing the best — rather than only scaling the model up.

def: 模型生成看似合理但实际错误的内容。源于它是按概率生成文本，而非查证事实。
defEn: Output that reads as plausible but is factually wrong. It follows from generating text by probability rather than checking facts.

def: 让模型的行为符合人类意图与价值观的研究方向，包括有用性、诚实性和无害性。
defEn: The research direction concerned with making a model's behaviour match human intent and values: helpfulness, honesty and harmlessness.

def: 通过特殊话术绕过模型的安全限制，使其输出被禁止的内容。
defEn: Using crafted phrasing to bypass a model's safety limits and get it to produce prohibited content.

def: 把恶意指令藏在 AI 会读取的内容里（网页、文档），诱使它违背原本的指令。Agent 场景下的主要安全风险。
defEn: Hiding malicious instructions inside content the AI will read — a web page, a document — to make it act against its original instructions. The main security risk in agent settings.

def: 上下文越长，模型对其中信息的利用效率越低，关键信息容易被忽略。
defEn: The longer the context, the less efficiently a model uses what's in it. Key details get missed.

def: 模型能同时理解和生成多种形式的信息，如文本、图像、音频、视频。
defEn: A model that can understand and generate several forms of information at once: text, images, audio, video.

def: 能看懂图像并与之对话的模型，常用于截图问答、图表理解、文档解析。
defEn: A model that can read images and talk about them. Common uses: answering questions about screenshots, understanding charts, parsing documents.

def: 根据文字描述生成图像。主流方案基于扩散模型，常配合负面提示词与工作流调优。
defEn: Generating images from a text description. Most current approaches use diffusion models, often with a negative prompt and a tuned workflow.

def: 根据文字生成视频片段。难点在时序一致性与物理合理性，是当前竞争最激烈的方向之一。
defEn: Generating video clips from text. The hard parts are temporal consistency and physical plausibility — which is why this is one of the most hotly contested areas right now.

def: 把文字转成语音。现代方案可做到音色克隆与情感控制，多语言配音已相当自然。
defEn: Converting text to speech. Modern systems do voice cloning and emotional control, and multilingual dubbing is now quite natural.

def: 面向企业客户 / 面向个人用户。AI 产品的商业模式与合规要求在这两侧差异很大。
defEn: Selling to businesses versus to individuals. Business model and compliance requirements differ sharply between the two.

def: 公开模型参数，可自行下载、运行、微调。注意：开源权重不等于开源训练数据与代码，商用前要看许可证。
defEn: Model parameters published for anyone to download, run and fine-tune. Note: open weights are not the same as open training data or code — read the licence before commercial use.

def: 对由 AI 生成或深度合成的内容进行标注的要求，多地已有法规或平台规则约束。
defEn: Requirements to label content that was AI-generated or synthesised. Several jurisdictions and platforms now mandate it.

def: 用 AI 合成高度逼真的虚假人脸、声音或视频。在诈骗、名誉侵权方面风险突出。
defEn: Synthesising convincingly realistic fake faces, voices or video. The risk concentrates in fraud and reputational harm.

def: 模型规模跨过某个门槛后突然出现、小模型完全没有的能力。它意味着「小模型做不好」不等于「大模型也做不好」。
defEn: Capabilities that appear suddenly once a model crosses a size threshold and are entirely absent in smaller ones. It means 'a small model can't do it' does not imply 'a large one can't either'.

def: 描述模型性能与参数量、数据量、算力之间关系的经验规律。它解释了为什么大厂都在堆规模，也解释了单纯堆规模收益递减的边界。
defEn: Empirical relationships between model performance and parameter count, data volume and compute. They explain why labs keep scaling up — and where the returns start diminishing.

def: 不改模型权重，只靠提示词里给的示例就学会新任务。这是大模型最反直觉的能力之一。
defEn: Learning a new task from examples in the prompt, without changing any weights. One of the most counterintuitive properties of large models.

def: 控制输出随机性的参数。越低越确定、越保守；越高越发散、越有创意。代码和事实类任务用低温度，头脑风暴用高温度。
defEn: A parameter controlling output randomness. Lower is more deterministic and conservative; higher is more varied and creative. Use low for code and factual work, high for brainstorming.

def: 只从累积概率达到 p 的那批词里采样。比温度更精细——它能剪掉长尾里的荒谬选项，同时保留合理范围内的多样性。
defEn: Nucleus sampling: draw only from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability reaches p. Finer-grained than temperature — it cuts off the absurd tail while keeping reasonable variety.

def: 在对话开始前设定的高优先级指令，用来定义 AI 的身份、能力边界和行为准则。对模型的影响远大于单条用户消息。
defEn: High-priority instructions set before the conversation begins, defining the AI's identity, capability boundaries and behavioural rules. Its influence far exceeds any single user message.

def: 把不变的长前缀（系统提示、知识库）缓存起来，后续请求直接复用，显著降低延迟和费用。做长文档问答必开。
defEn: Caching an unchanging long prefix — a system prompt, a knowledge base — so later requests reuse it, cutting latency and cost substantially. Effectively mandatory for long-document Q&A.

def: 逐个生成 Token、每生成一个就把它当作下一步输入的机制。这是「大模型只能往前写、不能回头改」的根本原因。
defEn: Generating one token at a time, each becoming part of the input for the next. This is the root reason a model can only write forward and cannot go back and revise.

def: 让模型知道词序的机制。现代方案多为旋转位置编码（RoPE），它决定了上下文窗口能扩到多长。
defEn: The mechanism that tells a model about word order. Most modern systems use rotary position encoding, and it determines how far the context window can be extended.

def: 当前主流的位置编码方式，通过旋转向量来编码相对位置，外推性好，是长上下文模型的基础。
defEn: The dominant positional encoding today. It encodes relative position by rotating vectors, extrapolates well, and is the basis of long-context models.

def: 一类替代 Transformer 注意力机制的架构（如 Mamba），推理时显存和计算量随长度线性增长，处理超长序列更省。
defEn: A family of architectures that replace Transformer attention (Mamba and similar). Memory and compute grow linearly with length, so very long sequences are cheaper to process.

def: 不在像素空间而在压缩后的潜在空间做扩散，大幅降低算力需求。Stable Diffusion 的核心思路。
defEn: Running the diffusion process in a compressed latent space rather than pixel space, which cuts compute dramatically. The core idea behind Stable Diffusion.

def: 模型学习语言规律所用的原始语料。数据的质量、去重程度、配比直接决定模型上限——这在业内已是共识。
defEn: The raw corpus a model learns language patterns from. Its quality, deduplication and composition directly set the model's ceiling — this is now industry consensus.

def: 预训练时不同来源语料的比例。中文能力弱、代码能力强这类差异，很多时候是配比决定的而不是架构。
defEn: The proportions of different sources in pre-training. Differences like weak Chinese and strong code are often decided by the mixture rather than the architecture.

def: 让模型生成多个候选，只保留正确答案的那些作为训练数据。是合成数据流水线里的关键一环。
defEn: Generating several candidates and keeping only the correct ones as training data. A key step in synthetic data pipelines.

def: 不训练奖励模型，直接用「好答案/坏答案」的偏好对优化模型。比 RLHF 简单稳定，已成为主流替代方案。
defEn: Optimising directly on pairs of preferred and rejected answers, without training a reward model. Simpler and more stable than RLHF, and now the mainstream alternative.

def: 一种强化学习优化方法，通过组内相对比较来估计优势，省掉了价值模型。推理模型的训练常用它。
defEn: Group Relative Policy Optimization. A reinforcement learning method that estimates advantage by comparing within a group, removing the need for a value model. Commonly used to train reasoning models.

def: 用模型生成、再经筛选的训练数据。当真实数据用尽时这是继续提升的主要手段，但要防「模型近亲繁殖」导致退化。
defEn: Training data generated by a model and then filtered. When real data runs out this is the main way to keep improving — but guard against the degradation that comes from a model training on its own output.

def: 在新数据上微调后，模型丢失了原有的通用能力。这是微调时最常见也最容易被忽视的问题。
defEn: Losing general capability after fine-tuning on new data. The most common and most easily overlooked problem in fine-tuning.

def: 让模型同时探索多条推理路径，评估后选最优。比思维链更强但成本更高，适合需要试错的规划类任务。
defEn: Having the model explore several reasoning paths at once, evaluate them, and pick the best. Stronger than chain-of-thought but more expensive — suited to planning tasks that need trial and error.

def: 同一问题采样多次，取多数答案。能显著提高数学和逻辑题的准确率，代价是调用次数成倍增加。
defEn: Sampling the same question several times and taking the majority answer. Markedly improves accuracy on maths and logic, at a multiple of the call cost.

def: 让模型交替进行「推理」和「调用工具」，用外部结果修正自己的判断。Agent 的基础范式。
defEn: Alternating between reasoning and calling tools, using external results to correct its own judgement. The foundational pattern for agents.

def: 让模型检查自己的输出并改进，多轮迭代。对代码和写作类任务提升明显。
defEn: Having the model examine its own output and improve it over several rounds. Noticeable gains on code and writing tasks.

def: 强制模型按指定 JSON Schema 输出。生产环境必备——否则下游程序随时可能解析失败。
defEn: Forcing the model to emit JSON matching a given schema. Effectively required in production — otherwise downstream parsing can fail at any time.

def: 把长文档切成检索单元。切太碎语义断裂，切太大检索不准——这是 RAG 效果好坏的头号变量。
defEn: Splitting long documents into retrieval units. Too small and the meaning fragments; too large and retrieval loses precision. This is the single biggest variable in RAG quality.

def: 先粗召回一批，再用更精细的模型重新排序。通常能明显提升 RAG 的答案质量，成本可控。
defEn: Roughly retrieving a batch, then re-ordering it with a more precise model. Usually improves RAG answer quality noticeably, at manageable cost.

def: 向量检索 + 关键词检索一起用。纯向量检索遇到专有名词、编号、代码符号时会失效，这是必须补的短板。
defEn: Vector search combined with keyword search. Pure vector search fails on proper nouns, identifiers and code symbols — this closes that gap.

def: 把问题和文档都转成向量，按相似度找最接近的。擅长语义匹配，不擅长精确匹配。
defEn: Converting both the query and the documents into vectors and finding the closest by similarity. Strong at semantic matching, weak at exact matching.

def: 让 AI 跨对话记住信息的机制，通常分短期（当前上下文）、长期（外部存储）、工作记忆（中间结果）三层。
defEn: How an AI remembers information across conversations. Usually layered: short-term (current context), long-term (external storage) and working memory (intermediate results).

def: 把多个模型调用、工具调用按预定流程图串起来。相比让 Agent 自由发挥，工作流更可控、更可调试。
defEn: Wiring multiple model and tool calls together along a predefined flow. Compared with letting an agent improvise, workflows are more controllable and easier to debug.

def: 多个各有所长的 AI 分工协作完成复杂任务。效果取决于分工设计和通信协议，盲目堆数量只会互相干扰。
defEn: Several specialised AIs dividing work on a complex task. Results depend on how the roles and communication are designed — piling on more agents just means they interfere.

def: 边生成边返回，而不是等全部生成完再给。对体感速度影响极大——首字延迟比总耗时更影响用户感受。
defEn: Returning tokens as they are generated rather than waiting for the whole response. It has an outsized effect on perceived speed — time to first token matters more to users than total duration.

def: 用标准化题目衡量模型能力。注意：榜单分数高不等于在你的场景里好用，且存在训练数据污染的问题。
defEn: Standardised tests used to measure model capability. Note: a high leaderboard score doesn't mean it works in your scenario, and contamination is a real problem.

def: 测试题不小心进了训练数据，导致分数虚高。这是看榜单时最需要警惕的陷阱。
defEn: Test questions accidentally ending up in training data, inflating the score. The trap most worth watching for when reading leaderboards.

def: 用另一个模型给输出打分。成本低可规模化，但裁判本身有偏好（偏爱长答案、偏爱自己的输出），必须做校准。
defEn: Using one model to score another's output. Cheap and scalable, but the judge has preferences of its own — it favours long answers and its own output — so calibration is required.

def: 主动用对抗性输入攻击自己的 AI 系统，在上线前找出安全漏洞。做面向公众的 AI 产品是必做项。
defEn: Attacking your own AI system with adversarial input to find security holes before launch. Effectively mandatory for anything public-facing.

def: 在训练数据里掺入恶意样本，让模型在特定输入下产生错误行为。开源模型权重尤需警惕。
defEn: Inserting malicious samples into training data so the model misbehaves on specific inputs. Open weights deserve particular caution here.

def: 模型因训练数据中的偏差，对特定群体产生系统性不公。在招聘、信贷、医疗等场景后果严重。
defEn: Systematic unfairness toward particular groups, inherited from bias in the training data. The consequences are serious in hiring, credit and healthcare.

def: 理解模型为什么做出某个决策。对高风险领域（医疗、金融、司法）是合规刚需，目前仍是难题。
defEn: Understanding why a model made a particular decision. A compliance requirement in high-stakes fields — medicine, finance, law — and still an unsolved problem.

def: 模型因为安全限制过严，连正常请求也拒绝。这是「安全对齐做过头」的典型副作用，严重影响可用性。
defEn: A model refusing legitimate requests because its safety constraints are too tight. The classic side-effect of over-tuning, and it badly damages usefulness.

def: 每次调用产生的费用，通常按输入和输出 Token 分别计价。输出通常比输入贵数倍，因为要逐个生成。
defEn: The cost of each call, usually priced separately for input and output tokens. Output typically costs several times more, because it is generated one token at a time.

def: 从发出请求到收到第一个字的时间。它比总耗时更影响用户的主观感受。
defEn: The time from sending a request to receiving the first token. It affects how fast a system feels more than total duration does.

def: 把模型跑在自己机房或私有云里。金融、医疗、政企客户的常见合规要求，代价是失去云端模型的迭代速度。
defEn: Running the model in your own data centre or private cloud. A common compliance requirement in finance, healthcare and government — at the cost of losing the cloud model's release cadence.

def: 直接跑在手机/PC 上的小模型。优势是零延迟、数据不出设备；劣势是能力受限，通常与大模型配合使用。
defEn: A small model running directly on a phone or PC. The upside is zero latency and data that never leaves the device; the downside is limited capability, so it is usually paired with a larger model.

def: 规定模型能怎么用的法律文件。常见坑：限制月活用户数、限制商用场景、要求衍生模型沿用同一协议。
defEn: The legal terms governing how a model may be used. Common traps: monthly active user caps, restricted commercial scenarios, and requirements that derivatives carry the same licence.

def: 对 AI 生成或深度合成的内容进行标注的要求。多地已有法规，平台侧也在加自动检测。
defEn: Requirements to label AI-generated or synthesised content. Several jurisdictions have legislation now, and platforms are adding automatic detection.

def: 为了让模型更安全、更符合人类偏好，而牺牲掉的那部分原始能力。安全与能力之间的取舍是长期议题。
defEn: The capability sacrificed to make a model safer and more aligned with human preferences. The trade-off between safety and capability is a long-running argument.

def: 评估 Agent 完成多步任务的能力，比单轮问答难得多——要看最终结果，也要看中间步骤是否合理、有没有绕路。
defEn: Measuring an agent's ability to complete multi-step tasks. Much harder than single-turn Q&A — you have to judge the final result, but also whether the intermediate steps were sound and whether it took a detour.

def: 把复杂任务拆成可独立验证的子步骤。这是让 AI 完成复杂工作的核心技巧——拆得好，成功率远高于让它一次做完。
defEn: Splitting a complex task into independently verifiable steps. The core technique for getting AI to finish complex work — decomposed well, the success rate far exceeds asking for it all at once.

def: 在自动流程的关键节点插入人工确认。务实做法：把不可逆操作挡在人工确认之后，可验证的重复劳动交给 AI。
defEn: Inserting human confirmation at key points in an automated flow. The pragmatic approach: put irreversible actions behind a human gate, hand verifiable repetitive work to the AI.

def: 在模型的输入输出两端加规则或小模型做检查，拦截越界内容与敏感操作。不依赖大模型自己守规矩。
defEn: Rules or small models checking input and output at the boundaries, catching out-of-bounds content and sensitive actions. Do not rely on the model to police itself.

def: 用实体和关系组织知识的结构化表示。与 RAG 结合（GraphRAG）能回答需要多跳推理的问题，而纯向量检索做不到。
defEn: A structured representation of knowledge as entities and relationships. Combined with RAG (GraphRAG) it answers questions requiring multi-hop reasoning, which pure vector search cannot.
